title: My good friend
summary: A boy describes his best friend and what they like doing.

sentences.zh: 我有一个好朋友，他叫小东。
sentences.en: I have a good friend called Xiaodong.

sentences.zh: 小东是我的同学，我们都十二岁。
sentences.en: Xiaodong is my classmate; we're both twelve.

sentences.zh: 他很高兴，也很喜欢说话。
小东会说一点儿汉语，也会做饭。
sentences.en: Xiaodong can speak a little Chinese, and he can cook.
I can't cook; I can sing.

sentences.zh: 下课的时候，我们喜欢在外边玩。
sentences.en: After class, we like playing outside.

sentences.zh: 我的同学有的喜欢看书，有的喜欢看电影。
sentences.en: Some of my classmates like reading, others like films.

sentences.zh: 我和小东都喜欢看电影。
sentences.en: Xiaodong and I both like films.

sentences.zh: 星期六，我们去电影院看电影。
sentences.en: On Saturdays we go to the cinema.

questions.prompt: How old are the two boys?
why: It's 十二, not 二十.

questions.prompt: What can Xiaodong do that the writer can't?
why: Right: 小东…会做饭。我不会做饭.
The writer is the one who can sing.
Right: 我和小东都喜欢看电影.
Some classmates like books; the two friends like films.
